## About Myself
My name is Nqobile Mngometulu from the Kingdom of Eswatini in Southern Africa. 

## Career
I have been working in primary health care for nearly a decade, with roles in midwifery, NCD management, HIV/TB care, Immunization, Cervical cancer screening , data analysis and procurement for my facility. The country recently introduced the digital health record/reporting, laboratory and logistics systems which I've had the priviledge to manage in my facility and thus my new found passion for data science. 

## Future Aspiration
It is my hope to work in data analysis teams, analysing data using programming languages to influence data driven decisions such as resource planning.
